Create an interstate shipment for the merchant using a signed quote_id obtained from POST /v1/rates. The request must include an Idempotency-Key header. Repeating a request with the same key is safe and returns the original result; reusing the key with a different request body returns a conflict. The merchant's prepaid balance is debited atomically with shipment creation. The shipment is assigned to the environment of the authenticating API key.
